release: Name Resolution Render Coalescing & Thumbnail Trace Telemetry
name: Name Resolution Render Coalescing & Thumbnail Trace Telemetry
changes: Coalesces All Posts filename-resolution activity updates so start, retry, and finish states update in place instead of rebuilding the full article/package DOM.
Retains result-driven full renders when resolved filenames, classifications, deferred state, or request errors materially change visible package presentation.
Adds passive browser thumbnail trace timing for task-queue wait, local thumbnail HTTP round-trip, browser post-processing, and full-preview recovery by browsing mode.

Classifies backend image-thumbnail failures by the existing preview error code while preserving v3.6.62 progressive header reuse, 800-header bounds, concurrency budgets, private SABnzbd 5.1.2, Discover and Automation behavior.
regression_guards: Name-resolution start/retry/finish state changes use targeted DOM updates; full list/package renders remain result-driven.
Thumbnail queue/HTTP/post/recovery timing stays passive and bounded; backend failure-code classification uses existing preview_error_info semantics.
v3.6.62 progressive first-paint seed reuse and 800/800/1000 header tuning remain unchanged.
All carried behavioral guards remain mandatory; SAB 5.1.2 and terminal-history schema 3 remain unchanged.
